title: The running maximum bounds its initial value
statement: Let $\alpha$ be a type, let $f : \alpha \to \mathbb{N}$, let $a \in \mathbb{N}$, and let $L$ be any finite list of elements of $\alpha$. Folding $(u,b) \mapsto \max(u,f(b))$ over $L$, starting from $a$, produces a value at least $a$.
